title: mallard list models --format json
description: The gas models a case chooses between and the keys that select each. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

input.description: The input file given, or null.

current.description: The name of the model the input chooses; null without an input or when its keys match none.

name.description: perfect, frozen, finite_rate or flamelet; more may come.

docs.description: The guide section, relative to the source tree.

sets.description: Each key the model sets, with its value as TOML.

requires.description: Keys the model needs that have no default.

removes.description: Keys and tables the model does not read.
